title: Kasane
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: Kasane Fuchi, bullied all her life for her looks, is a gifted actress who cannot perform as herself. Her late mother, a famous beauty, left her a lipstick that swaps faces with anyone she kisses. Kasane strikes a deal with a beautiful but untalented actress, Nina, to take over her face on stage, and as resentment, a suicide attempt and further stolen identities follow, the psychological thriller asks what a self is when talent and beauty belong to different people.
life_message: The story questions whether beauty, talent and identity can be bought or stolen, and shows the cost of trying.
